title: Strategic roadmap and protocol enhancement proposals for enterprise platform evolution
body:
Analyzed codebase (109+ protocols across 5 domains) and created comprehensive strategic plan to evolve ObjectStack into industry-leading enterprise management platform with AI automation.

## Deliverables

**4 documents, 110K+ characters total:**

- **Executive Summary** (`content/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md`, 14K) - Current state, 6-phase plan, success metrics, team structure
- **Strategic Roadmap** (`content/STRATEGIC_ROADMAP_2026.md`, 30K) - Detailed protocol specifications for 6 missing core capabilities
- **Implementation Guide** (`content/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md`, 34K) - 5 implementation patterns with production examples (data objects, workflows, AI agents, dashboards)
- **Protocol Enhancement Proposals** (`content/PROTOCOL_ENHANCEMENTS.md`, 32K) - 6 PEPs with complete Zod schemas and acceptance criteria

## Key Analysis

**Missing core protocols (6 identified):**
- Document Storage (NoSQL with versioning, full-text search)
- Advanced Search Engine (faceted search, relevance ranking, typo tolerance)
- Object Storage (CDN, image processing, lifecycle policies)
- Predictive Analytics (ML training, deployment, monitoring)
- Message Queue (async processing, retry policies)
- Enhanced Notification System (multi-channel, preferences, analytics)

**Protocol Enhancement Proposals prioritized by impact:**
- **P0 (2-3 weeks)**: Search Engine, Notification Enhancement
- **P1 (4-6 weeks)**: Object Storage, Predictive Analytics, Message Queue
- **P2 (6-8 weeks)**: Multi-Modal AI, Real-Time Collaboration

## Implementation Roadmap

**Q1 2026**: Core protocol completion (Search, Notification, Object Storage, Message Queue)  
**Q2 2026**: Predictive Analytics, Multi-Modal AI  
**Q3 2026**: Real-Time Collaboration, Visual IDE Phase 1  
**Q4 2026**: Visual IDE Phase 2, v1.0 release

**Success metrics defined:**
- Technical: <100ms API response (P95), 10K+ concurrent users, >99.9% uptime
- Business: 10x dev speed, 80% code reduction, 5x faster time-to-market
- Ecosystem: 10K+ GitHub stars, 1K+ enterprise customers by 2027

## Example: Predictive Analytics Protocol

```typescript
// Complete Zod schema for ML model definition
export const PredictiveModelSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().regex(/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/),
  type: z.enum(['classification', 'regression', 'timeseries', 'clustering', 'anomaly_detection']),
  algorithm: z.enum(['random_forest', 'gradient_boosting', 'lstm', 'prophet', /* ... */]),
  
  features: z.array(z.object({
    name: z.string(),
    type: z.enum(['numeric', 'categorical', 'datetime', 'text', 'embedding']),
    transformation: z.enum(['normalize', 'standardize', 'one_hot', /* ... */]).optional(),
  })),
  
  training: z.object({
    dataSource: z.union([/* object, query, file sources */]),
    splitStrategy: z.enum(['random', 'time_based', 'stratified']),
    autoRetrain: z.object({
      enabled: z.boolean().default(false),
      schedule: z.string().optional(), // cron
      performanceThreshold: z.number().optional(),
    }).optional(),
  }),
  
  deployment: z.object({
    enabled: z.boolean().default(false),
    realtime: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
    latencyTarget: z.number().positive().optional(),
  }).optional(),
});
```

**Team recommendation**: 13-18 engineers (4 backend, 3 frontend, 3 AI/ML, 2 DevOps, 2 QA, 1 architect, 1 PM, 1 tech writer)
